set_alert.name: Set alert
set_alert.description: Raises an alert on behalf of a caller. The alert stays on until every caller that set it has cleared it.

alert_id.name: Alert ID
alert_id.description: Identifies the caller raising the alert.

clear_alert.name: Clear alert
clear_alert.description: Withdraws a caller's alert. The alert turns off once the last caller has cleared it.

alert_id.name: Alert ID
alert_id.description: Identifies the caller clearing the alert.

reset_alert.name: Reset alert
reset_alert.description: Clears the alert for all callers at once.
